columns:
The Committee carried out a deep dive into the Risk Governance for Material Projects covering the planning,
impact assessment, implementation and post implementation assurance events. The deep dive was
informed by recommendations arising from the Committee Effectiveness Review as well as discussions in
the Committee regarding the roll-out of the SC Mobile key enhancement, the client impact therefrom and
the lessons learnt from the experience. The Committee reviewed the project management governance
framework and made appropriate recommendations to enhance the process.
